desc:
Gary is the WORST bus driver in Busville... and you're stuck on his bus!

Prank your way across town without getting caught. When Gary checks his mirror, SIT DOWN and act cool! Get caught 3 times and he throws you off the bus, so grab a scooter and chase it down!

PRANKS: steal Gary's hat, honk his horn, chug his coffee, tie shoelaces together, stick a KICK ME sign, spitballs and more
CHAOS: live chickens, ball pits, air horns, fireworks, a kiddie pool with a SHARK
WILD EVENTS: a clown car, Turbo Granny races, a giant donut rolling after the bus, hydrants that launch you into the sky, a ghost on board, a goat eating homework and more
MAYHEM MODE: total chaos, double points
Too loud? The cops pull Gary over!

Every ride is different. Earn coins, unlock gear in the shop and climb the leaderboards.

Play on phone, tablet, PC or console!

Like and Favorite for new pranks and events!
